rule: For whole-frame p50 and p95, compare median(after)-median(before) with the larger full within-build range. A positive change beyond that range fails. Retain all p99/max separately. Descriptive noise rule, not an equivalence test.
baseline: Three native before windows reused at unchanged 7357f78 and identical DLL from evidence commit 7937557935ef658c8410d2f2070a21058311e307; every after window rerun at 7a104d6.
sequence: Identical checkpoint, normal speed, ten-second warmup, 60-second sample, manual saves and reloads outside measurement. Three before historical windows versus three new after windows.
diagnostics: Detailed optional traces and admission probes disabled. No concurrent rig offline builds or tests during primary after windows; other system workloads remain uncontrolled.
